A magical Christmas storybook

The Ornament That Wanted to Be a Star

High on the tree, above the tinsel and the lights, a little red ornament dares to dream.

Pip is the smallest ornament on the tree — but he has the biggest dream of all. Join him on a glowing, snow-dusted climb past old friends and twinkling lights, all the way to the shining Star at the very top. A warm, sparkling Christmas tale for little dreamers and the grown-ups who read with them.

Begin the climb

Far below the treetop…

Down among the lowest branches hangs Pip — a little red ornament with a very big dream. Night after night he gazes up at the glowing Star and whispers, “One day, I'll climb that high.”

A shimmer of gold

Higher up, Tinsel Girl is draped in glittering garland from head to boots. She twinkles with encouragement: the climb is long, but brave little ornaments never give up.

A beat of courage

Pip's branches creak and the lights blur below — until the little Drummer Boy strikes up a marching rhythm. Boom-boom-boom! Suddenly the climb feels like an adventure.

Sweet company

Near the top, the Candy Cane grins from his snowy perch. With a sugary cheer and a peppermint wink, he shows Pip the last few branches — the ones no ornament has ever climbed.

The glowing Star

And there it is — the golden Star, warm and bright at the very top of the tree. The climb was impossible… and Pip did it anyway. Because some dreams shine brightest when you dare to reach for them.

Meet the characters

Friends on the Branches

Pip

The little red ornament with the biggest dream on the tree — small, shiny and utterly unstoppable.

Tinsel Girl

Draped in sparkling garland, she lights the way and cheers every brave climber onward.

The Drummer Boy

His tiny drum turns a scary climb into a marching song — courage has a rhythm.

The Candy Cane

Sweet, stripey and always smiling, he guards the last branches before the top.

The Star

The glowing dream at the very top — proof that the highest branches belong to those who climb.

About the book

A Dream Big Enough to Climb

Pip is a little red ornament hanging far below the twinkling lights of the family Christmas tree. Above him, past the tinsel and the pine branches, the golden Star glows — and Pip can't stop dreaming about reaching it.

So begins a magical nighttime climb. Along the way Pip meets the friends who make the tree feel like a world of its own: the sparkling Tinsel Girl, the brave little Drummer Boy, and the sweetly smiling Candy Cane. Each of them teaches Pip something about courage, friendship, and what it really means to shine.

The Ornament That Wanted to Be a Star is a warm bedtime story about daring to dream, perfect for reading aloud together on December nights — and for anyone who has ever felt small but dreamed tall.
